summary.zh: 建立三到五年财务预测模型
summary.en: Build 3-5 year startup financial models and scenarios.

description.zh: 搭建三到五年的收入预测、成本结构、现金流与情景分析，并测算资金消耗和可支撑时间。适合准备种子轮或 A 轮融资材料，或检验现有商业计划的财务可行性。
description.en: Builds three-to-five-year revenue projections, cost structure, cash flow, and scenarios, including burn rate and runway. Fits seed or Series A fundraising prep or stress-testing a business plan.
